name: Training Ray Marching (Forward Only)
aliases: Ray Marching with Sparse Voxel Grid (Training)
definition: A training-specific ray marching function that estimates the maximum number of points to allocate based on mean count from previous epochs, enabling faster training by avoiding over-allocation, while supporting force-all-rays mode for stability.
summary: Training Ray Marching is a two-pass GPU algorithm that decouples counting occupied samples from writing data to enable dynamic memory allocation based on actual occupancy rather than fixed bounds.
